claim: BLOS2 is encoded by the Bloc1s2 gene.

claim: Bloc1s2−/− mice are embryonic lethal.

claim: The localization of Notch1 (NTM) exhibited a marked increase in the EEA1 and CD63-labeled fractions in Bloc1s2−/− brains compared to WT.

claim: There is accumulation of Notch1 (NTM) in endosomes with loss of BLOS2.
